claims: All Target stores in the United States will be closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
Target closes for the full day to allow employees to spend time with family on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
Shoppers can use Target.com and the Target app for online orders on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
Costco, Sam's Club, and ALDI are closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
Walmart, CVS, and Walgreens are expected to be open on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
